name: Beth de Araújo
bio: Beth de Araújo (born 27 July 1985) is a Brazilian-American filmmaker. She is best known for directing the films Soft & Quiet (2022) and Josephine (2026).

credits.title: Josephine
credits.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

credits.title: Soft & Quiet
credits.overview: Taking place in real time, elementary school teacher Emily organizes a mixer of like-minded women, but an altercation between a woman from Emily’s past and the group leads to a volatile chain of events.

credits.title: I Want to Marry a Creative Jewish Girl
credits.overview: An Asian American who looks for love in superficial and external ways. It's bittersweet because she doesn't end up finding what she wants, but makes a very intimate connection with her overweight neighbor, a man she would never consider dating.

credits.title: Chevy Chase
credits.overview: An Oxycontin addict fighting her urge to keep using.

credits.title: Initiation
credits.overview: When a college senior is reluctant to haze her freshman soccer teammates, she's bullied into becoming the worst culprit of them all.

credits.title: Brown Bag
credits.overview: A hapless high school girl who loves a classmate and goes to extremes to receive his love in return.
